items.title: Peter LaCaze Interview, 1972-01-27
items.q: The mention of Mineta occurs entirely within the [INTERVIEWER]'s turn ('I used to study under Mineta'). The [INTERVIEWEE] does not mention Mineta, nor does he respond to the name, indicating no personal connection or knowledge is demonstrated in the transcript.

ctx.x: I call it a valve trombone too, but I heard some people call it a tenor.
Well, a slide trombone is a tenor trombone. I used to study under Mineta, remember? Oh, yeah, yeah. I studied the slide trombone, which is a tenor, you know, it's that B-flat trombone. Yeah.

Who was playing that horn? Do you remember that? No, I don't know, I don't remember who was playing that horn. The only one I can remember playing the horn was that man Perez and the reason I remember him, because I was more interested in what he was doing than the balance of it. And what other bands did you remember around that time? Other bands, what I was supposed to play that time, well. This is before you started playing. Yeah, that was before I started playing.
